# Whole-ride validation (auto-generated by scripts/11_validate_rides.py)

420 random trips (3–18 km, 06–22 h) on the held-out days 25–31 Oct; the model and its ride calibration only saw 1–24 Oct. For each bus leg of the planner's best option, real buses of the **same route** on **that day** that left the boarding stop within ±15 min of the planned time were followed to the alighting stop in the GPS stop visits. 378 of 759 legs had at least one such bus (median ride 21 min, 12 stops; the rest: the GPS missed the boarding or alighting stop, or no bus of that route ran in the window).

## Ride time (boarding stop → alighting stop)

| | legs | MAE min | bias min | MAPE % | median APE % | within 20 % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| GTFS timetable | 378 | 6.7 | -2.0 | 26.1 | 21.9 | 46 |
| GPS stretch model (no ride calibration) | 378 | 5.4 | -4.3 | 17.6 | 14.2 | 67 |
| **BusPulse planner** (GPS model + ride calibration) | 378 | 4.5 | -2.2 | 16.6 | 12.6 | 70 |

The stretch model alone under-predicts whole rides: real rides include long halts at timing points, jams slower than 3 km/h and stops the GPS missed, which the clean stretch observations leave out. The ride calibration (median actual/planned ratio per time of day, estimated on training-day rides) corrects that.

By ride length (MAPE %):

| actual ride | legs | median min | timetable MAPE % | BusPulse MAPE % |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| < 15 min | 147 | 8 | 29.7 | 17.6 |
| 15–30 min | 94 | 22 | 26.1 | 15.6 |
| 30–45 min | 67 | 34 | 21.6 | 16.8 |
| > 45 min | 70 | 58 | 23.1 | 15.7 |

### With the live blend (same legs)

The live blend replays that day's GPS of the 15 min before departure.

| | legs | MAE min | bias min | MAPE % | median APE % | within 20 % |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BusPulse planner | 360 | 4.5 | -2.2 | 16.6 | 12.2 | 69 |
| BusPulse planner + live blend | 360 | 4.5 | -2.2 | 16.5 | 12.8 | 70 |

## Is the range honest?

The planner's ride range comes from whole-ride ratios on training days (18–24 Oct). On the held-out week:

| range | claimed % | observed % |
|---|---|---|
| inside 'usually' (p25–p75) | 50 | 43.9 |
| below p85 | 85 | 79.9 |
| below p90 ('on 9 of 10 days') | 90 | 89.9 |
| inside p10–p90 | 80 | 80.2 |

## Door to door (walk + wait + ride)

96 trips where every bus leg had real rides and a real wait at a well-detected stop that day (real = planned walking + real waits + real rides; median 72 min, 48 % with a change).

| | MAE min | bias min | MAPE % | within 20 % |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| GTFS timetable | 12.1 | -0.6 | 17.0 | 66 |
| **BusPulse** | 8.7 | -1.9 | 12.4 | 80 |

## Waiting time at the first stop

Actual = mean wait until the next real bus of that route for a passenger arriving at a random moment within ±10 min of the planned arrival, at stops where the GPS sees ≥ 80% of the route's buses (275 legs).

| | legs | actual mean min | predicted mean min | MAE min | bias min |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BusPulse (GPS headways incl. bunching, else timetable) | 275 | 16.4 | 13.6 | 9.4 | -2.8 |
| GTFS timetable (half the headway) | 269 | 16.3 | 9.1 | 10.1 | -7.1 |

Per-leg data: `data/model/ride_validation.csv`. Run time 229 s.
